subject: Cross-border safeguards: technical control matrix and follow-up (PulseHealth RFP)
messages:
From: PulseHealth Procurement <procurement@pulsehealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: control matrix + cross-border evidence for RFP (PulseHealth)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for your time last week. As part of PulseHealth's vendor evaluation we need a concise technical control matrix showing how Redwood meets the DPF controls requested in section 4 of our RFP, and any supporting evidence for EU->US transfer safeguards (SCCs/DPF mapping, encryption-in-transit at rest, KMS separation).

Specifically we need:
- Columnar control matrix mapping PulseHealth DPF controls to Redwood controls (technical owner, evidence file reference)
- Copy of the proposed DPA annex language for cross-border processing (we'd like to confirm wording prior to legal review)
- Any SOC 2 / ISO artefacts you can share or a link to where auditors can request them

Target timeline: can you provide a first-pass matrix + DPA annex by end-of-day Friday (2028-09-22)? If not, please propose an alternative.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can schedule legal review.

Best,
Anita Gomez
Sr. Sourcing Manager – Vendor Risk
PulseHealth

[Attachment: PH-RFP-Section4.pdf (referenced)]

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: control matrix + cross-border evidence for RFP (PulseHealth)

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear ask. We can meet that timeline with a couple of clarifications.

Quick answers: we will provide a control matrix mapping PulseHealth DPF controls to Redwood technical and organisational controls, and attach a DPA annex draft for your legal team. We will also include links to our SOC 2 report and a redacted evidence pack for cross-border safeguards.

Two clarifying Qs before we finalize the matrix:
1) For the DPF mapping, do you want separate rows for hosted vs private deployment footprints? (Redwood Hosted uses shared infrastructure; Dedicated/Private has customer-isolated pools)
2) Are you evaluating key custody (customer-managed KMS) as required or recommended?

Plan: I will send a first-pass control matrix + draft DPA annex by EOD 2028-09-22. Marissa & Ben — looping you for operational evidence pointers (SOC 2 link, export logs sample).

Regards,
Irene Choi
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

- PulseHealth legal needs to see the proposed DPA annex language before the SOC 2 review; small redlines preferred so procurement can slot it into our master services agreement.

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: control matrix + cross-border evidence for RFP (PulseHealth)

Hi Anita / Mark — attached is our first-pass package. Contents:
- PH-RFP-Control-Matrix.xlsx (matrix with deployment applicability and evidence references)
- redwood-dpa-annex-draft.docx (DPA annex language, redline-friendly; highlights customer-managed KMS options and fallback to SCCs/DPF mapping)
- SOC2-Redwood-ReadOnly-Link (one-time auditor request link provided via separate secure share)
- Export-mapping-summary.pdf (sequence diagrams + jurisdictional routing, redacted)

Notes / clarifications:
- We provided separate rows for Hosted vs Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses shared model-serving clusters but we enforce tenant isolation at the request-routing layer and prefix KV cache separation.
- Customer-managed KMS is available on Dedicated and Private; Hosted supports Bring-Your-Key (BYK) in our upcoming private deployment option — we noted this in the annex as an optional clause.
- For compliance evidence we will provide a limited, redacted export log sample and a procedural runbook showing how cross-border transfers are logged and audited. Full logs are provided only under NDA or via auditor request.

Next step: Please confirm receipt and indicate whether PulseHealth legal prefers the annex as-is, or if you'd like a tracked-changes Word copy. If you'd like an expedited review call, I'm available tomorrow morning PST.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PH-RFP-Control-Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-dpa-annex-draft.docx (word), Export-mapping-summary.pdf (pdf)
